prompt: A watercolor illustration captures a quiet moment on a subway platform. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral coat sits on a metal bench, her posture slumped with fatigue. Next to her, a small terrier with wiry fur rests its head on her knee, creating a tender bond between pet and owner. In the center, a businessman in a gray suit stands rigidly, holding a briefcase tightly against his side as he checks his wristwatch. To his right, a teenager in a blue hoodie leans against a tiled pillar, eyes fixed on a glowing smartphone screen. Further right, a street musician with a battered guitar case open at their feet strums softly, though no sound is depicted. Near the edge of the platform, a child in a yellow raincoat points excitedly at the approaching train lights in the distance. The mother of the child, wearing a green scarf, looks down at the pointing finger with a gentle smile. There is no advertisement visible on the walls, leaving the tiles bare and textured. The scene flows with soft edges and blended hues, emphasizing the transient nature of urban travel without sharp lines or harsh contrasts. The composition balances the stillness of the seated figures with the anticipation of those standing, all united by the shared space of the underground station.
